hypothesis: All-inclusive family resorts and teen modifiers are synonyms of broad family hotels or justify separate maintainable page jobs.

method.url_normalization: URL parser; lowercase host; remove leading www only, fragments and one non-root trailing slash; retain scheme, path case, queries, subdomains and country hosts
method.host_normalization: URL hostname only; no brand/eTLD or regional Tripadvisor collapse
method.scope: One returned organic snapshot, not guaranteed complete top ten, user test or future ranking
method.threshold: No arbitrary overlap threshold qualifies a new URL

sources.observation: Affiliate ten-property list groups city and regional resorts. It already covers activity, proximity and value criteria, kids/teen club labels, rooms and occupancy questions. The returned body supplies no same-party/same-stay exact-category nightly comparison or club prerequisite matrix. Broad safety and all-ages assurances are not adopted.
sources.limitations: Sampled returned text only; booking links not followed, current property facts and safety not validated or copied

sources.observation: A generic family-resort guide ranks for the teen query. Its body already addresses family-of-five space, optional all-inclusive versus kitchens, a capacity limitation, regional location and anecdotal transport costs. It claims firsthand experience; no current same-party/stay category-price-fee matrix is visible. This is a counterexample to claiming that existing guides omit larger-family or budget decisions entirely.
sources.limitations: Firsthand and safety assertions, transport amounts, room limits and program ages not adopted as Family Tripwise facts; inspection does not renew them

sources.observation: Travel-agency ten-property list covers packages, some kids-program ages and regional resorts, with a booking-service call to action. General spacious-suite or all-inclusive budget claims are not an exact five-person room/age/cost check. No matched-party dated fee comparison is visible in the returned body.
sources.limitations: Property/program/price claims unvalidated; date year unknown, no booking/contact or embedded social content retained

sources.scope: Category exclusions, Bahia larger-category candidate, Vallarta toilet-training prerequisite versus unknown readiness, regional/city base and missing actual-family quote retained; no blocked quote recovery

family_task_actual_price.dependency: 121 blank normal Hyatt quote page; check only changed rendering/session during eligible exact-family task, no unchanged retry or alternate tool

interpretation.broad_family: Returned broad set mixes hotel lists, OTA filters, property/destination pages and community leads; not coherent proof of a clean resort comparison job
interpretation.all_inclusive: More explicit resort comparison and package intent, but city versus Nayarit-region scope needs local labels and an exact family configuration/age/cost evidence layer
interpretation.teens: Community leads and generic family guides suggest an age-mix decision hypothesis, not demonstrated separate teen-page demand. Null provider metric is unknown, not zero.
interpretation.low_overlap: Zero exact URLs does not show mutually exclusive jobs. Shared hosts and generic family guide in teen set support checking age constraints inside one maintained resort comparison first.
interpretation.information_gain: Candidate normalized exact-category occupancy, booking-age basis, program prerequisites and costs, city/regional base, per-configuration dated nightly/fee context. Already-covered rooms/kitchens/transport are not novelty by themselves.

decision.outcome: CANDIDATE one maintained resort-comparison job; HOLD separate teen URL and city launch
decision.next_gate: Maintain multi-property exact configuration/age/base/full-cost and current-review corpus; run named mixed-age and no-car budget task against specialist coverage; materiality and no-existing-fit plus fresh named PV publication approval. Exact-family quote only after changed normal rendering.
decision.confidence: High deterministic overlap/budget/date controls; medium sampled intent/information-gain inference; unknown actual family task completion, full corpus, current teen demand, user outcomes or rankings
decision.falsification_trigger: A new controlled sample and two representative same-job queries, maintained exact-party dated corpus/task evidence, equivalent competitor comparison, or changed normal quote rendering; never cadence-only
